You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From bcfe9b6cbb4438b8c1cc4bd475221652c8f9301b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Date: Wed, 16 Mar 2022 12:20:02 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] virtio_blk: eliminate anonymous module_init & module_exit

Eliminate anonymous module_init() and module_exit(), which can lead to
confusion or ambiguity when reading System.map, crashes/oops/bugs,
or an initcall_debug log.

Give each of these init and exit functions unique driver-specific
names to eliminate the anonymous names.

Example 1: (System.map)
 ffffffff832fc78c t init
 ffffffff832fc79e t init
 ffffffff832fc8f8 t init

Example 2: (initcall_debug log)
 calling  init+0x0/0x12 @ 1
 initcall init+0x0/0x12 returned 0 after 15 usecs
 calling  init+0x0/0x60 @ 1
 initcall init+0x0/0x60 returned 0 after 2 usecs
 calling  init+0x0/0x9a @ 1
 initcall init+0x0/0x9a returned 0 after 74 usecs

Fixes: e467cde23818 ("Block driver using virtio.")
Signed-off-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Cc: "Michael S. Tsirkin" <mst@redhat.com>
Cc: Jason Wang <jasowang@redhat.com>
Cc: Paolo Bonzini <pbonzini@redhat.com>
Cc: Stefan Hajnoczi <stefanha@redhat.com>
Cc: virtualization@lists.linux-foundation.org
Cc: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>
Cc: linux-block@vger.kernel.org
Reviewed-by: Stefan Hajnoczi <stefanha@redhat.com>
Acked-by: Jason Wang <jasowang@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: Ira Weiny <ira.weiny@intel.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220316192010.19001-2-rdunlap@infradead.org
Signed-off-by: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

diff --git a/drivers/block/virtio_blk.c b/drivers/block/virtio_blk.c
index 5c636ca7f1a7..fa8abf982c64 100644
--- a/drivers/block/virtio_blk.c
+++ b/drivers/block/virtio_blk.c
@@ -1022,7 +1022,7 @@ static struct virtio_driver virtio_blk = {
 #endif
 };
 
-static int __init init(void)
+static int __init virtio_blk_init(void)
 {
 	int error;
 
@@ -1048,14 +1048,14 @@ static int __init init(void)
 	return error;
 }
 
-static void __exit fini(void)
+static void __exit virtio_blk_fini(void)
 {
 	unregister_virtio_driver(&virtio_blk);
 	unregister_blkdev(major, "virtblk");
 	destroy_workqueue(virtblk_wq);
 }
-module_init(init);
-module_exit(fini);
+module_init(virtio_blk_init);
+module_exit(virtio_blk_fini);
 
 MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(virtio, id_table);
 MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Virtio block driver");
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/block/virtio_blk.c`**
   - The anonymous initialization function `init()` has been renamed to `virtio_blk_init()`.
   - The anonymous exit function `fini()` has been renamed to `virtio_blk_fini()`.
   - The calls to `module_init()` and `module_exit()` have been updated to use the new function names `virtio_blk_init` and `virtio_blk_fini`, respectively.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in the `virtio_blk.c` file are aimed at eliminating the use of anonymous module initialization and exit functions, which can cause confusion in logs and system maps. By giving these functions unique names specific to the virtio block driver, the patch enhances clarity and traceability in debugging and system monitoring. The changes ensure that the module's initialization and exit processes are distinctly identifiable, improving the overall maintainability of the code.

Based on your summary and the commit message in the patch, you need to:

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 
2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug. 



Provide a response strictly in the following format:
Root cause:<Root cause>

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
-static int __init init(void)
-static void __exit fini(void)
```
Reason:
The use of anonymous module initialization (`init`) and exit (`fini`) functions can create confusion in system logs, as multiple functions may appear with the same name. This ambiguity makes it difficult to trace issues related to module loading and unloading, complicating debugging efforts when diagnosing crashes or bugs.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+static int __init virtio_blk_init(void)
+static void __exit virtio_blk_fini(void)
```
Reason:
By giving unique names to the module initialization (`virtio_blk_init`) and exit (`virtio_blk_fini`) functions, the ambiguity in system logs is eliminated. This allows for clearer tracing of module activities, making it easier to diagnose issues related to the virtio_blk driver during loading and unloading.
